device.meaning: Whole disk or loop device to set up, named by a single /dev basename; the device is reobserved before a mutation.

role.meaning: NAS role whose partition label is sought.

blank.meaning: True only when no partitions and no filesystem, partition-table or LUKS signature are present.

contents.meaning: Observed partition and signature details, never file names.

partlabel.meaning: Partition label, or null when absent.

type.meaning: Filesystem, LUKS or partition-table type, never a file name; null when absent.

partUuid.meaning: PARTUUID of the role-labelled partition, or null when none stands.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: none means no refusal; nas-prefire-device-invalid means the device is invalid, nas-prefire-device-unobservable means it cannot be observed, and nas-prefire-command-failed means an observation command failed.
